articles.title: 参院本会議 有人国境離島保全で改正法成立 6島を追加
articles.summary: 国境に近い離島を無人島にしないよう、船や航空便の運賃を低く抑えるなどの支援策を盛り込んだ法律について、対象となる島を新たに6つ追加し、有効期限を10年間延長する改正法が、参議院本会議で成立しました。

articles.title: 茨城 高齢者施設2人殺害事件 元職員に懲役20年 一部無罪
articles.summary: 6年前、茨城県古河市の高齢者施設で84歳と76歳の入所者2人の血管に点滴用のチューブを経由して空気を注入し、殺害した罪に問われた40歳の元職員に対し、水戸地方裁判所は76歳の入所者に対する殺人の罪などについて懲役20年の判決を言い渡しました。一方、もう1人の入所者に対する殺人の罪については「元職員を犯人というのは合理的な疑いが残る」として無罪を言い渡しました。

articles.title: 衆院憲法審査会 9日に「合区」などテーマに2回目の討議で合意
articles.summary: 衆議院で法案審議が再開される見通しとなったことを受けて、衆議院憲法審査会の幹事懇談会は、9日に審査会を開き、参議院の選挙区で導入されている「合区」などをテーマにした2回目の討議を行うことで、与野党が合意しました。

articles.title: 衆院議運委 皇室典範改正案 10日審議入りで与野党が合意
articles.summary: 衆議院で法案審議が再開される見通しとなったことを受けて、衆議院議院運営委員会は理事会を開き、皇族数の確保に向けた皇室典範改正案を10日、審議入りさせることで与野党が合意しました。また与党側は、その日のうちに採決したいと提案し、引き続き協議することになりました。

articles.title: 自民 集中審議開催方針 中道 皇室典範改正案審議入り応じる
articles.summary: 自民党と中道改革連合の国会対策委員長が断続的に会談し、自民党は野党側の要求に応じて衆議院予算委員会の集中審議を今の国会の会期中に開催する方針を伝えました。これを受けて、中道は皇室典範改正案の審議入りなどに応じる考えを示し、衆議院での法案審議が再開する見通しとなりました。

articles.title: 参議院 法案審議再開へ 衆議院では与野党対立続く
articles.summary: 国会では、参議院で与党側が予算委員会の集中審議などの開催に応じたことを受けて、7日から法案審議が再開されます。一方、衆議院では、皇族数の確保に向けた皇室典範改正案の審議入りなどをめぐって対立が続いていて、与党が打開策を検討しています。

articles.title: 高市首相 “皇室典範改正案など国会運営に万全を” 自民役員会
articles.summary: 国会の会期末が7月17日に迫る中、高市総理大臣は自民党の役員会で、皇族数の確保に向けた皇室典範改正案や、衆議院議員の定数削減などの法案が残っているとして、連携して国会運営に万全を尽くすよう指示しました。

articles.title: 自維幹部 皇室典範改正案審議入りを 維新“必要あれば延長も”
articles.summary: 国会の会期末が来週に迫る中、自民・維新両党の幹部が会談し、皇室典範改正案の衆議院での審議入りに向けて野党との協議を急ぐ方針を確認しました。また、維新は、衆議院の定数削減法案などの成立を目指し、必要があれば会期の延長を検討するよう求めました。

articles.title: 自民 小林政調会長 皇室典範改正案は今国会で確実に成立を
articles.summary: 国会で与野党の対立が続く中、自民党の小林政務調査会長は、皇族数の確保は喫緊の課題だとして、皇室典範改正案を今の国会で確実に成立させたいという考えを示しました。一方、衆議院議員の定数削減法案の審議再開に向けては野党との丁寧な協議が必要だという認識を示しました。

articles.title: 国会 与党に会期延長論も 高市首相の意向踏まえ対応検討へ
articles.summary: 国会では、与党が皇室典範改正案に加えて、衆議院議員の定数削減法案などの成立を目指す姿勢を崩しておらず、会期の延長もやむをえないという声も出ています。一方、野党は予算委員会の集中審議の開催などを重ねて求めていて、与党が高市総理大臣の意向も踏まえて今後の対応を検討することにしています。

articles.title: 与党 皇室典範改正案審議入りを 野党 定数削減法案断念を
articles.summary: 国会の会期末まで2週間となる中、与党は皇族数の確保に向けた皇室典範改正案を優先して成立させたいとしています。これに対して野党は、衆議院議員の定数削減法案などの成立を断念することや、予算委員会の集中審議などの開催を重ねて求めていて、こう着状態が続いています。

articles.title: 仏ルペン氏 控訴審も有罪 上告し大統領選挙に立候補の意向

articles.title: NASA celebrates America's 250th birthday with incredible views of space
articles.summary: NASA is marking the United States' 250th birthday with four striking red, white, and blue images of deep space from the Chandra X-ray Observatory. articles.title: Schrödinger’s anthill: Quantum entanglement found in a crystal large enough to hold
articles.summary: A centimeter-sized crystal has revealed clear signs of quantum entanglement, showing that large, everyday objects can display surprisingly deep quantum behavior. articles.title: Creatine doesn't just build muscle. It may also help fight cancer
articles.summary: Scientists have discovered that creatine may strengthen one of the immune system's most important cancer-fighting pathways by energizing dendritic cells that activate killer T cells. The promising results could eventually help make immunotherapy more effective, but they have not yet been tested in h...

articles.title: New calculator reveals whether you should really worry about statin side effects
articles.summary: Scientists at the University of Oxford have created a calculator that predicts a person's individual risk of serious muscle disorders from statin medications. Their analysis found that more than 98% of people who qualify for statins are at low risk for these rare complications, despite widespread co...

articles.title: Scientists discover a completely different way to fight viruses
articles.summary: Researchers have uncovered an unexpected antiviral defense system in sea anemones that works very differently from the one humans use. The discovery suggests evolution developed multiple ways to combat viruses, challenging long-held ideas about how animal immune systems evolved.

articles.title: Scientists may have finally found how Alzheimer's spreads through the brain
articles.summary: A common brain protein may be giving Alzheimer’s disease an unexpected way to spread, carrying toxic Tau proteins from damaged neurons into healthy ones. By blocking these harmful protein packages before they reach new cells, researchers believe it may one day be possible to slow the disease's relen...

articles.title: Scientists say creatine may help fight depression
articles.summary: Creatine is best known as a muscle-building supplement, but scientists are now investigating whether it could also help treat depression by boosting the brain's energy supply. A new review examined five randomized clinical trials involving 238 participants and found mixed results. Two studies, both ...

articles.title: Millions may be getting the wrong cholesterol test
articles.summary: A new study suggests that apoB, a blood test that measures harmful cholesterol particles, is better than standard LDL cholesterol testing for deciding who needs more intensive treatment. Researchers found it could prevent more heart attacks and strokes while remaining cost-effective for the U.S. hea...

articles.title: A strange LIGO signal could reveal the missing link behind dark matter
articles.summary: An unusual gravitational wave signal has renewed hopes that primordial black holes, long considered purely theoretical, may finally be within reach of discovery. If confirmed, they could solve one of astronomy's greatest mysteries by explaining the nature of dark matter.

articles.title: Great ape laughter reveals a hidden origin of human speech
articles.summary: The rhythm of human laughter appears to have deep evolutionary roots shared with chimpanzees, bonobos, gorillas, and orangutans. That ancient pattern may offer one of the clearest clues yet to how the vocal control needed for human speech gradually evolved.

articles.title: Scientists may have finally found how Alzheimer's kills brain cells
articles.summary: Researchers have identified a previously overlooked mechanism of brain cell death that appears to play a major role in Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal dementia. The finding could lead to new treatments aimed at slowing neuron loss by interrupting the process before cells are destroyed.

articles.title: Astronomers witness the birth of a magnetar for the first time
articles.summary: A strange "chirping" signal from a distant supernova has revealed the birth of a magnetar, confirming that these incredibly magnetic neutron stars can power the universe's brightest stellar explosions. The discovery also marks the first time Einstein's general relativity has been used to explain the...

articles.title: The Neanderthal “love story” isn’t what the DNA actually shows
articles.summary: Claims that Neanderthal men "preferred" Homo sapiens women may make for catchy headlines, but the underlying research does not actually show prehistoric romance. The genetic evidence only points to an uneven pattern of DNA inheritance, which could have been shaped by biology, migration, or social or...

articles.title: Scientists create quantum sound device that could transform communications
articles.summary: A new quantum device can generate precisely controlled bursts of sound-like particles, or phonons, by forcing electrons through an ultra-thin crystal at extremely low temperatures. articles.title: Scientists discover the deep sleep circuit that builds muscle, burns fat, and boosts the brain
articles.summary: Researchers have identified the brain circuitry that links deep sleep with the release of growth hormone, revealing how the two regulate each other. The newly discovered feedback loop helps explain why poor sleep can interfere with growth, muscle repair, fat metabolism, and brain function. Understan...

articles.title: Scientists discover a surprising link between vitamin C and brain health
articles.summary: Could something as simple as vitamin C help support a healthier aging brain? articles.title: New AI model reveals how neutron star mergers forge heavy elements
articles.summary: Researchers have created an AI-based simulation that makes it much faster to model how neutron star mergers produce many of the universe's heaviest elements. The new tool could improve predictions of these powerful explosions while helping scientists better connect observations in space with experim...

articles.title: Einstein Probe may have caught a black hole tearing apart a white dwarf for the first time
articles.summary: Astronomers may have witnessed one of the rarest and most dramatic cosmic events ever seen: a long-sought intermediate-mass black hole ripping apart a dense white dwarf star and devouring it. The Einstein Probe space telescope caught the explosion in its earliest moments, revealing an unusual sequen...

articles.title: Ancient bees turned tooth sockets into tiny nurseries 20,000 years ago
articles.summary: A stunning fossil discovery shows that ancient bees used the empty tooth sockets of mammal bones as tiny nests after owls scattered the bones across a cave floor 20,000 years ago. It's the first known evidence of bees nesting inside animal bones, revealing an astonishingly creative survival strategy...

articles.title: 390 gravitational wave detections reveal hidden population of black holes
articles.summary: Astronomers have released the largest gravitational wave catalog ever, revealing 161 new black hole collisions and pushing the total number of detections to 390. articles.title: They knew the pill was fake but their memory still improved
articles.summary: Healthy older adults experienced measurable improvements in memory, physical performance, and stress after taking placebo pills for just three weeks. The most surprising finding was that the placebo often worked even when participants knew the pills were completely inactive.

articles.title: New optical centrifuge unlocks the secrets of frictionless superfluids
articles.summary: Physicists have developed a new optical centrifuge that can precisely spin molecules inside a superfluid for the first time. The advance could help unravel some of the biggest mysteries of quantum liquids and reveal how superfluidity breaks down at the atomic scale.

articles.title: This spray-on powder can stop life-threatening bleeding in 1 second
articles.summary: A new spray-on powder developed by KAIST can stop life-threatening bleeding in about one second by instantly forming a strong gel over a wound. It works on deep and irregular injuries where conventional hemostatic products often struggle and remains effective even after years of storage in harsh con...

articles.title: Melanoma's secret to cheating death has finally been revealed
articles.summary: Scientists have solved a long-standing mystery by discovering the missing genetic ingredient that helps melanoma cells become effectively immortal. The breakthrough could open the door to new treatments aimed at disrupting one of cancer's most important survival strategies.
